config.advancedcauldron.title: Advanced Cauldron Config
config.advancedcauldron.brewTimeTicks.to: How many ticks a brew takes to complete. Default: 400 (20 seconds).
config.advancedcauldron.itemPickupDelayT: Minimum item age in ticks before cauldron picks it up. Default: 10.
config.advancedcauldron.arrowsPerCauldro: Number of arrows that can be tipped per cauldron level. Default: 16.
config.advancedcauldron.heatDamageEnable: Whether entities take damage in heated cauldrons.
config.advancedcauldron.heatDamageAmount: Damage per hit from heated cauldrons. 1.0 = half a heart.
config.advancedcauldron.heatDamageDelayT: Ticks before heat damage starts. Default: 40 (2 seconds).
config.advancedcauldron.heatDamageInterv: Ticks between each heat damage tick. Default: 20 (1 second).
config.advancedcauldron.steamParticlesEn: Show steam particles above heated cauldrons.
config.advancedcauldron.brewingBubblePar: Show colored bubble particles during brewing.
config.advancedcauldron.suppressCampfire: Hide campfire smoke when a cauldron is placed above it.
Master toggle for all cauldron freezing from snow and cold biomes.
config.advancedcauldron.snowFillingEnabl: Snow accumulates in empty cauldrons and snow-filled cauldrons.
config.advancedcauldron.rainFillingEnabl: Rain fills cauldrons via random ticks (faster, scales with randomTickSpeed).
config.advancedcauldron.freezeChance.too: Chance per precipitation tick to freeze or fill from snow (0.0 to 1.0). Default: 0.05 (5%).
config.advancedcauldron.biomeTemperature: Cauldrons freeze in cold biomes and thaw in warm biomes based on temperature.
